description: This file implements custom middleware for a FastAPI (Starlette-based) backend API, specifically a middleware that logs request details and associates a request ID with each HTTP request.

classes.name: RequestIdLoggingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware that attaches a request ID to each request, logs request/response with timing, and propagates the request ID via headers.

methods.name: None __init__(self, app)
methods.description: Initializes the middleware with the application and sets up a logger.

methods.name: Response dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next: Callable[[Request], Awaitable[Response]])
methods.description: Handles each incoming request by attaching a request ID, recording timing, logging request and response details, and ensuring the request ID is included in the response headers.

ctags.name: dispatch
ctags.pattern: /^    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next: Callable[[Request], Awaitable[Response/
